Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error when comparing the birthdates of Keith Bostic and Jerry Glanville. The Planner incorrectly concluded that Jerry Glanville is younger than Keith Bostic despite having earlier birthdate information for Jerry Glanville (born October 14, 1941) compared to Keith Bostic (born January 17, 1961). This mistake stems from misinterpreting the chronological timeline, assuming that the later year (1961) corresponds to being older, contrary to proper chronological logic. This aligns with the "Anachronistic Conclusion" and "Numerical Inconsistencies" error patterns from Example 1.
